metadata.description: Mock SovereignOps Historical Incident Runbooks & Post-Mortems Dataset

runbooks.title: Auth Database Connection Pool Exhaustion Fix
runbooks.error_signature: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable - Auth DB Connection Timeout
runbooks.historical_fix: Increased Auth DB Max Connections pool size from 100 to 500 and restarted db-auth-cluster primary node.

runbooks.title: External Payment Gateway Timeout Mitigation
runbooks.error_signature: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout - External Payment API Unreachable
runbooks.historical_fix: Switched payment-service traffic to secondary payment provider fallback endpoint.

runbooks.title: Orders Database Deadlock Resolution
runbooks.error_signature: SQL state 40P01 - Deadlock detected in db-orders-cluster
runbooks.historical_fix: Cancelled blocking transactions and deployed patch to reorder SQL lock acquisition.

runbooks.title: User Service Cache Invalidation Failure
runbooks.error_signature: HTTP 500 Internal Error - Stale Cache in user-service
runbooks.historical_fix: Flushed Redis cache cluster and restarted user-service pods.
